issues.display_title: Issue #464: API Published Folder Bookmark Detail
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 15/07/26

✅ Implementation: Published Folder Bookmark Detail API

Example API

Endpoint: GET /bookmark/published/:slug
Description: Retrieves paginated posts inside a published folder bookmark. This endpoint returns only post list data and dynamic totals. Folder/header data should come from GET /search/folder-bookmark/published.

Example cURL Request

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  -H "ec: false" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Request Parameters

  • slug (string, required): Published folder bookmark slug.
  • page (int, optional): Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
  • limit (int, optional): Number of posts per page. Defaults to 10.

Visibility Rules

  • Role viewer can access public published folder posts.
  • Role user can access public published folder posts.
  • Other roles return 401 Unauthorized.
  • All roles exclude:
    • deactive users
    • private/non-public posts
    • unpublished posts
    • video360 posts
  • Role user also excludes:
    • blocked users
    • blocked posts

Data Source

This endpoint reads from:

public.views_published_folder_posts

Required view columns:

  • folder_slug
  • bookmark_created_at
  • slug
  • username
  • avatar
  • description
  • thumbnail
  • post_type
  • potd
  • counter_view
  • counter_like
  • counter_comment
  • visibility
  • is_publish
  • encrypt

Success Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Published Folder Bookmark Detail",
    "posts": [
      {
        "slug": "post-slug",
        "username": "sunnybreeze",
        "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
        "description": "Travel is not just about visiting new places.",
        "short_description": "Travel is not just about visiting new places.",
        "long_description": "",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg",
        "post_type": "panorama",
        "potd": false,
        "counter_view": 48,
        "counter_like": 3,
        "counter_comment": 21
      }
    ],
    "total_posts": 19,
    "total_views_all_posts": 328000,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10
  }
}

Empty Or Not Found Response

If no visible posts are available for the requester, the endpoint returns 409.

{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "status": "Conflict",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Folder Not Found"
    }
  }
}

Unauthorized Response

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "status": "Unauthorized",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Unauthorized"
    }
  }
}

FE Usage Example

Use search endpoint first to get folder/header data:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/search/folder-bookmark/published" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=8" \
  --data-urlencode "q=CN Tower" \
  --data-urlencode "category=0"

Then use the selected folder slug to load posts:

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/bookmark/published/<slug>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10"

Summary

Implemented a bookmark-owned public detail endpoint that returns only posts and dynamic totals for a published folder. Folder/header data is intentionally excluded so FE can reuse data from /search/folder-bookmark/published.

Endpoint

Implementation Details

Action

Created PublishedFolderBookmarkDetail in src/Action/V1/Bookmarks.

Behavior:

  • Reads slug from route params.
  • Supports role viewer and user.
  • Rejects unsupported roles with 401 Unauthorized.
  • Loads deactive users from Redis key:
    • <prefix>_deactive_users_ec
  • For role user, loads:
    • user data through UserFunctions.UserDatas
    • blocked users from <prefix>_blocked_users_ec_<encrypt>
    • blocked posts from <prefix>_blocked_post_ec_<encrypt>
  • Uses views_published_folder_posts as the source table/view.

Base query filters:

Config.DB.Table("views_published_folder_posts").
    Where("folder_slug = ?", folderSlug).
    Where("visibility = ?", "public").
    Where("is_publish = ?", true).
    Where("post_type != ?", "video360")

Additional filters:

if len(blockPost) != 0 {
    query.Where("slug NOT IN (?)", blockPost)
}

if len(notInEncrypt) != 0 {
    query.Where("encrypt NOT IN (?)", notInEncrypt)
}

Totals:

  • total_posts uses COUNT(*) from the filtered query before pagination.
  • total_views_all_posts uses COALESCE(SUM(counter_view), 0) from the same filtered scope.

Post list:

Select("slug, username, avatar, description, thumbnail, post_type, potd, counter_view, counter_like, counter_comment").
Order("bookmark_created_at DESC").
Limit(limit).
Offset(offset)

Description processing:

  • html.UnescapeString

Route

Final route:

GET /bookmark/published/:slug

issues.display_title: Issue #466: Update API Search Published Folder Bookmark
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 15/07/26

✅ Implementation: Update Search Published Folder Bookmark API

Example API

Endpoint: GET /search/folder-bookmark/published
Description: Retrieves a list of publicly published folder bookmarks from all creators. This endpoint powers the Bookmark tab in the Search Discover page, providing infinite scroll capabilities, full-text search, and category filtering.

Example cURL Request

curl -G "http://localhost:3000/search/folder-bookmark/published" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>" \
  --data-urlencode "page=1" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=10" \
  --data-urlencode "q=holiday" \
  --data-urlencode "category=0" \
  --data-urlencode "include=slug,name,thumbnail,user,total_bookmark"

Request Parameters

  • page (int, optional): Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
  • limit (int, optional): Number of items per page. Defaults to 8.
  • q (string, optional): Keyword to search published folders by name. (Also supports name as an alias for backward compatibility).
  • category (int, optional): Filter by category_id. Passing 0 or omitting it skips the category filter.
  • include (string, optional): Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (e.g., slug,name,user). Using this limits the output only to the specified fields.

Success Response

The response includes the folder details along with nested user, geo location, and a strictly formatted total_bookmark object.

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Search Published Folder Bookmarks",
    "bookmarks": [
      {
        "slug": "holiday-places-2024",
        "name": "Holiday Places",
        "description": "Places to visit",
        "location": {
            "lat": -8.409518, 
            "lng": 115.188919
        },
        "location_name": "Bali",
        "category_name": "Leisure",
        "published_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "potd": false,
        "total_bookmark": {
            "counter_bookmak": 5
        },
        "thumbnail": "sample.jpg",
        "user": {
            "username": "tester",
            "fullname": "Tester Account",
            "avatar": "avatar.jpg",
            "encrypt": "abcd123"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Error Responses

Unauthorized (User context invalid or missing):

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "error": "Unauthorized"
  }
}

Internal Server Error (Database connection failure):

{
  "statusCode": 500,
  "data": {
    "error": "Internal Server Error"
  }
}

Update API Search Published Folder Bookmark Implementation

Summary

Updated /search/folder-bookmark/published so it can provide all folder/header data needed by the published folder detail page. FE can now pass detail page folder data from search results and call /bookmark/published/:slug only for posts and totals.

Endpoint

GET /search/folder-bookmark/published?page=1&limit=8&q=keyword&category=0

Also supports:

name as alias for q.

Files Changed

  • src/Models/SearchModel.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Search/Search Published Folder Bookmark.yml

Implementation Details

Role Handling

The endpoint now supports both:

  • viewer
  • user

Unsupported roles return 401 Unauthorized.

For viewer:

  • Does not call UserFunctions.UserDatas.
  • Uses current timestamp as lastLogin fallback for encrypted response flow.
  • Applies deactive owner filtering.

For user:

  • Calls UserFunctions.UserDatas.
  • Uses actual last_login.
  • Applies deactive owner filtering.
  • Applies blocked owner filtering.

Query Fields

The DB query always selects the fields needed for FE detail header:

description,

location_name,
category_name,

total_bookmark,

This is intentional even when include is sent, because the action still needs internal fields for formatting and user object assembly.

owner_encrypt NOT IN deactiveUser

  • q or name filters name ILIKE
  • category filters category_id
  • page and limit paginate
  • include filters response fields

Existing Response Compatibility

Kept existing total_bookmark shape:

  "counter_bookmak": 19
}

The typo counter_bookmak is preserved for compatibility.

Notes

  • include still controls final response filtering.
  • Default response includes full folder detail fields.
  • Search result is now sufficient for detail page header data.

RESULT 15/07/26

✅ Implementation: Create views_published_folder_posts And Indexes Implementation

Summary

Prepared the DB view and indexes needed by GET /bookmark/published/:slug. The view uses views_timeline_post_slim as the counter source because its aggregate JSON is already available in the database and has known shape.

View Name

public.views_published_folder_posts

Counter Source

views_timeline_post_slim exposes:

views_aggregate = {"aggregate": {"count": 48}}
comments_aggregate = {"aggregate": {"count": 21}}
likes_aggregate = {"aggregate": {"count": 3}, "nodes": []}

The new view extracts integer counters:

  • counter_view
  • counter_like
  • counter_comment

View DDL

Run the full statement, from CREATE through ;.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_published_folder_posts AS
SELECT
    fb.id AS folder_id,
    fb.slug AS folder_slug,
    b.created_at AS bookmark_created_at,
    vts.id AS post_id,
    vts.slug AS slug,
    vts.description AS description,
    vts.thumbnail AS thumbnail,
    vts.post_type AS post_type,
    vts.visibility AS visibility,
    true AS is_publish,
    vts.data_user::jsonb #>> '{encrypt}' AS encrypt,
    vts.data_user::jsonb #>> '{username}' AS username,
    vts.data_user::jsonb #>> '{avatar}' AS avatar,
    CASE
        WHEN br_folder.folder_id IS NOT NULL OR vts.potd = true THEN true
        ELSE false
    END AS potd,
    CAST(COALESCE(vts.views_aggregate::jsonb #>> '{aggregate,count}', '0') AS bigint) AS counter_view,
    CAST(COALESCE(vts.likes_aggregate::jsonb #>> '{aggregate,count}', '0') AS bigint) AS counter_like,
    CAST(COALESCE(vts.comments_aggregate::jsonb #>> '{aggregate,count}', '0') AS bigint) AS counter_comment
FROM public.bookmark AS b
JOIN public.folder_bookmark AS fb ON fb.id = b.folder_id
JOIN public.views_timeline_post_slim AS vts ON vts.id = b.post_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT folder_id
    FROM public.broadcast
    WHERE folder_id IS NOT NULL
) AS br_folder ON br_folder.folder_id = fb.id
WHERE fb.is_published = true;

Index DDL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_folder_bookmark_published_slug
ON public.folder_bookmark (slug)
WHERE is_published = true;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bookmark_folder_created_at
ON public.bookmark (folder_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bookmark_post_id
ON public.bookmark (post_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_broadcast_folder_id
ON public.broadcast (folder_id)
WHERE folder_id IS NOT NULL;

Optional, only if these do not already exist:

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_posts_publish_banned_user_id
ON public.posts (is_publish, banned, user_id, id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_id_banned
ON public.users (id, banned);

API Query Shape

The API reads:

SELECT
    slug,
    username,
    avatar,
    description,
    thumbnail,
    post_type,
    potd,
    counter_view,
    counter_like,
    counter_comment
FROM public.views_published_folder_posts
WHERE folder_slug = $1
  AND visibility = 'public'
  AND is_publish = true
  AND post_type != 'video360'
ORDER BY bookmark_created_at DESC
LIMIT $2
OFFSET $3;

For total_posts:

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM public.views_published_folder_posts
WHERE folder_slug = $1
  AND visibility = 'public'
  AND is_publish = true
  AND post_type != 'video360';

For total_views_all_posts:

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(counter_view), 0)
FROM public.views_published_folder_posts
WHERE folder_slug = $1
  AND visibility = 'public'
  AND is_publish = true
  AND post_type != 'video360';

Verification

FROM public.views_published_folder_posts
LIMIT 5;
